notes: The terminal published as 5.73.0 through 5.73.3 did not boot. pfViewLabelInit() was called beside the portfolio rail, at offset 667,792 of the emitted document, and wrote into a PF_VIEW_LABEL var that was not declared until offset 895,026 — so it was undefined when the call executed, the write threw, and boot died before the page registered the control channel. Which means the failure mode was not an error message: it was a blank window, and an agent that could not connect to be asked about it. Four published releases carried it. PF_VIEW_LABEL is now derived where PF_VIEWS is declared, in one
